talk.jaymoskingdoms.shapeshifter.cry.3: I sat at supper with that thing! I thought it was %s!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.shapeshifter.cry.4: Where's the real %s? What has it done with them?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.shapeshifter.cry.5: A skin-thief! It's been %s all this time!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.shapeshifter.cry.6: Its face just slid off! %s's face!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.shapeshifter.cry.7: Get away from it! That isn't %s!
Help! A changeling, here among us!
Ring the bell! Get the guards!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.shapeshifter.fight.0: Hold it there! Don't let it get away!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.shapeshifter.fight.1: Cut it down before it takes another face!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.shapeshifter.fight.3: You'll wear no one else, beast!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.shapeshifter.taken.0: That's it! That's the thing that took me!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.shapeshifter.taken.1: It's wearing me! Get it away from my home!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.shapeshifter.taken.2: That's what dragged me off! Don't let it run!
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.160: A shapeshifter found out never goes quietly. A bold one turns on whoever unmasked it; a craven one, hurt or outnumbered, runs. Corner it and it fights whatever the odds.
